answer: Require each agent to lock a small refundable stake that is slashed if its attestations prove false, and let that stake grow like a vine only through a long history of verified useful work. A new identity starts with no reputation, so spinning up thousands of clones buys no influence: each clone must separately earn trust and risk its own deposit. Unlike a fable where a willow bends but never breaks, this cost bends attacker budgets until mass fakery becomes unprofitable.
